# Apex Enterprise Solutions (AES)

Apex Enterprise Solutions is a North America-based field execution partner for IT infrastructure deployment. AES supports fiber, structured cabling, rack-and-stack, and AI/data center deployments across North America — primarily as a subcontract execution partner to prime contractors, systems integrators, MSPs, telecom and network providers, IT staffing companies, and data center operators.

Website: https://www.apexsolutions.io
Email: info@apexsolutions.io
Phone / Text: (669) 251-7810
Headquarters: 1069 Duane Ct, Sunnyvale, CA 94085

## Core Services

- **Structured Cabling & Fiber** — CAT6 / CAT6A copper, OS2 / OM3 / OM4 fiber, terminations, fusion splicing, OTDR and power meter testing per approved scope, copper certification with Fluke DSX or equivalent, ANSI/TIA-606 (or owner-approved) labeling, as-builts, full closeout documentation.
- **Rack & Stack / Data Center Refresh** — Rack assembly, server / switch / appliance mounting, PDU install and circuit labeling, BIOS/firmware validation, burn-in support, asset tagging, CMDB-ready inventory, hardware refresh, decommissioning, smart hands.
- **AP Refresh / Wireless Rollouts** — Multi-site wireless AP replacement and validation, controller and cloud-managed AP onboarding (coordinated with the client's network engineer for RF design and policy), post-install RF validation, freezer / cooler / harsh-environment installs.
- **Smart Hands & Field Support** — Hardware swap, site survey, asset validation, decommissioning, remote hands, rack audit, IDF cleanup, AP troubleshooting, single-site or rapid-response field engagements.

## Primary Buyers

- Prime contractors and general contractors
- Systems integrators
- Managed service providers (MSPs)
- Telecom and network service providers
- IT staffing and field services companies
- Data center operators and developers
- Enterprise IT teams (direct engagement)

## Industries Served

- Data Centers & Colocation
- Logistics & Warehousing
- Telecom & Service Providers

## Coverage

United States and Canada. Active field coverage includes:
- **U.S.**: San Francisco Bay Area (CA), Los Angeles (CA), Dallas–Fort Worth (TX), Las Vegas (NV), Memphis (TN)
- **Canada**: Greater Toronto Area (ON) including Scarborough, Mississauga, Brampton, Bolton, Oakville; Calgary (AB), Edmonton (AB)
- Additional U.S. and Canadian markets supported on a project basis

## Delivery Model

AES operates as a subcontract execution partner with a flexible delivery model built around trusted field resources and partner-led opportunities. AES does not bypass partner project managers, does not poach partner clients, and does not publish project details without written authorization. Insurance includes general liability and E&O coverage; licensing and bonding are verified per project jurisdiction.

## Documentation Deliverables

- OTDR trace files (fiber)
- Power meter test results (fiber)
- Copper link certification reports (Fluke DSX or equivalent)
- Labeling records aligned with ANSI/TIA-606 or owner-approved schema
- As-built drawings
- Rack elevation diagrams
- CMDB-ready asset inventory
- Burn-in test reports
- RF survey reports and coverage validation heatmaps (AP refresh)
- Daily progress reports during execution
- Complete closeout pack at handover

## Engagement Model

1. Inquiry or scope submission (RFP, BOM, drawings, site list, or partner introduction)
2. Intro call and scope review within one business day of submission
3. NDA and partner / subcontract agreement as needed
4. First deployment
